body.name: spectralCriterion
body.construction: Diagonalize the joint higher-order score in the eigenbasis \((v_j(P))\), derive for each identity or resolvent filter the exact extremal ratio of source-constrained noncentrality to the sum of null fluctuation, higher-order nuisance remainder, and empirical-operator error, and realize every failing extremal sequence by a legal causal submodel.
